Class WorkbenchJson

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.WorkbenchJson
public final class WorkbenchJson extends Object
Minimal JSON encoder + parser scoped to the workbench client's handshake + ack frames.

This package intentionally avoids a Jackson / Gson dependency (matching the rest of the TTI-O Java codebase: see BamDump and ProvenanceJsonParse for the hand-rolled pattern). The frames we handle are shallow: 5-6 top-level fields, scalar values (string, integer, boolean), one level of nesting for the download filter object.

NOT a general-purpose JSON library. Refuses comments, trailing commas, unicode escapes outside the BMP, scientific notation, and arrays of mixed types beyond what the workbench frames need.

Marked public only because the sub-packages auth and transport need to call into it. Treat as an internal utility -- not part of the SDK's API stability promise.

      public static String encode(Object obj)
      Emit obj as compact JSON (no whitespace between tokens). Output is a UTF-8-safe ASCII string -- non-ASCII codepoints emerge as \\uXXXX escapes.
